memories.content: Amnezia Control Panel — unified admin panel for Amnezia AWG2 + 3x-ui. Deployed on same VPN server. Single admin, small scale (1-3 servers, up to 50 users). Stack: Next.js 15 + React 19 + TypeScript + Prisma + SQLite + WebSocket. 47 fine-grained phases.
User wants ALL features in v1 — no deferrals. 42 requirements across auth, users, services, config, routing, chaining, monitoring, alerts.
Dark-first admin theme: slate-900 bg, blue-500 accents, Tailwind v4 + Prettier (2-space, single-quote, semicolons). Turbopack dev server.

Phases 1.1-2.1 complete (8/47). Commits: 1.1-1.4 init, 1.5 5cbcc2d (dark theme+prettier), 1.6 39f90fb (sidebar layout), 1.7 cfd2c5e (login page), 2.1 0617c7e (auth store zustand). Auth uses zustand, jose for JWT, bcryptjs.

realtime_memories.content: Phase 2.3 execute запущен. Жду завершения — Phase 2.4 (Protected Routes) зависит от middleware из 2.3.
Phases 3.1-3.7 запущены одним агентом. Это большой batch — ~7 фаз. Контекст 70% — после завершения этого агента нужно будет `/clear` и продолжить с Phase 4.1.
